12.t: Working with data: lynx and hares
q: In which year were there most hares?
Describe what happens to lynx numbers after hare numbers rise.
Lynx numbers rise a year or two later.
Explain why lynx numbers fall after the hares fall.
Less food for the predator, so fewer lynx survive and breed.
Suggest why these data may not show the real numbers.
They count animals trapped, not all animals; trapping effort may have changed; other causes (disease, food plants) not shown.
